card.name: Decimal points and units in dosing formulas
card.fires_on: Small pieces inside numeric dosing tables and formulas, such as a decimal point within a number, the word by in a height-squared formula, or the gap before a number or unit.

modes.label: Decimal points in table numbers
modes.description: The decimal point inside a number in an infusion or dosing table.

modes.label: Body-size formulas
modes.description: Words or symbols inside body mass or kidney function formulas.

modes.label: Unit and rate wording
modes.description: Spaces, unit letters or heading words next to amounts and rates.
modes.example: 30 mg of Oral Morphine Equivalents per Day : Initiate treatment with buprenorphine transdermal system 5 mc<<g>>/hour at the next dosing interval
